sentences.en: The monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
sentences.zh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念那位杰出的哲学家而建立的。

sentences.en: An immense monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念那位显赫的哲学家，建起了一座宏伟的纪念碑。

sentences.en: He is eminent both as a teacher and writer.
sentences.zh: 他既是优秀的教师也是著名的作家。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+min（突出）+ent（…的） →杰出的，显赫的
